rationale: Ground truth has essentially no substantive concerns (just an LGTM approval and an unrelated request to split off a VoxCPM2 fix), so neither candidate misses much, but Y earns its 'approve' conclusion by actually tracing the seed-propagation mechanism through serving_speech.py and gpu_model_runner.py with specific line citations, verifying test coverage impact, and offering two concrete, well-reasoned non-blocking suggestions (a guard comment at a specific line, noting the second seed removal is inert).
